name: io.github.yarenty/emperor-vikunja
title: Vikunja tasks
description: Vikunja tasks for MCP clients: list, read, create and update tasks, comment, list projects.

packageArguments.description: Speak MCP over stdin and stdout.
Serve only list_tasks, get_task and list_projects; the write tools are removed.

environmentVariables.name: VIKUNJA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your Vikunja, e.g. https://vikunja.example.com

environmentVariables.name: VIKUNJA_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to serve only the read tools (same as --read-only); unset, empty or false leaves them all on.
